tools.name: analyze_text
tools.description: Analyze text for sentiment, named entities, key phrases or PII redaction. This is a model-assisted local equivalent of Azure Language, not a trained NLP service; PII output is best-effort.

task.description: sentiment returns a label and confidence; entities returns named entities; keyphrases returns phrases; pii returns redactedText.

model.description: Optional chat deployment name or provider:model id. Defaults to the first running deployment.

tools.name: translate_text
tools.description: Translate text into a target language with the local chat deployment. Names, numbers and formatting are preserved by the prompt, but this is a model-assisted local equivalent of Azure Translator.

target.description: Target language name or code, e.g. Urdu, fr, Japanese.

model.description: Optional chat deployment name or provider:model id.
